name: fk-income-tax
description: Compute ordinary Falkland Islands individual income tax on calendar-year 2026 income. Covers resident and ordinarily resident individuals, employees, sole traders and partners, with non-resident boundaries. Use for personal allowance, taxable employment, business income, deductions, losses, annual return, POAT reconciliation and payment questions. Distinguishes income earned in 2026 from the year of assessment and the return delivered in 2027. Includes a basic calculation and a non-resident decision comparing final withholding with an assessment. It does not import UK allowances, National Insurance or capital gains rules. Includes ordinary prescribed benefits; specialist exemptions and pension-scheme approval need separate advice.
